'''Lamburt''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] [[Navy/Legends|navy]] and junior [[Deck officer/Legends|deck officer]] of the [[Bloodfin (Star Destroyer)|''Bloodfin'']] who informed [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] of a [[Natasi Daala|red headed woman's]] arrival, being too young to know her true identity.
